description: Cykelpumpar is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Helsingborgs stad. The dataset includes bicycle pumps. The bicycle pumps are owned by the City of Helsingborg and are compatible with most valves. The information is stored as points. Coverage: Helsingborgs stad. The portal shows the English title as "Bicycle pumps" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Helsingborgs stad. Its keywords include mobilitet, Helsingborgs stad, trafik, cykla, GIS, cykelpumpar. The listing shows 3 download or service links in GPKG, CSV. The listing shows 2022-04-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
